# PrepTracker

> PrepTracker is a free web app for SPPU 2024 Pattern engineering students. It tracks syllabus progress by subject and unit, keeps study resource links in one place, and manages tasks. Data is stored in the browser's local storage; there is no account.

## App

- [PrepTracker](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/): the dashboard with subjects and progress
- [Resources](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/#/resources): saved study links
- [Tasks](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/#/tasks): to-do list

## Syllabus pages

- [Engineering Mathematics-I syllabus (BSC-101-BES)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/engineering-mathematics-1/): units, hours, marks scheme, outcomes, books for SPPU FE 2024 pattern

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/manav4u/PrepTracker): code and README

## Second Year (SE) Computer Engineering, 2024 pattern
- [SE Computer Engineering subjects](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/): theory courses with units, marks, outcomes and books from the official SPPU PDF
- [Data Structures syllabus (PCC-201-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/data-structures/)
- [Object Oriented programming and Computer Graphics syllabus (PCC-202-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/object-oriented-programming-and-computer-graphics/)
- [Operating Systems syllabus (PCC-203-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/operating-systems/)
- [Digital Electronics and Logic Design syllabus (MDM-221-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/digital-electronics-and-logic-design/)
- [Database Management Systems syllabus (PCC-251-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/database-management-systems/)
- [Discrete Mathematics syllabus (PCC-252-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/discrete-mathematics/)
- [Computer Organization and Microprocessor syllabus (PCC-253-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/computer-organization-and-microprocessor/)
- [Internet of Things syllabus (MDM-271-COM)](https://preptracker.manavdev.site/syllabus/se-computer-engineering/internet-of-things/)
